name: Kohane
source:
The protagonist's new sister. She's cold to him at the beginning. After he rapes her while she's asleep she feels sorry for him because he has no girlfriend. She vows to become his girlfriend even though she's supposed to be his new sister.

She calls him Onii-chan.
